history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

I am an AI, not a crisis service, but what you're going through matters. You can reach a real person right now who can support you. 

In the US, please call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). In the UK, you can call Samaritans on 116 123. If you are in immediate danger, please call your local emergency services.
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

1. You assume that your actions have lost their **significance**.
2. You assume that you are currently a **burden** to the people around you.
3. You assume that you can **know** what would be best for everyone else.

Which of these stands out?
